note: Scott County VA (51169) has zoning (AF, AR, R-1, MHP, C-1, I-1 per county ordinance; official zoning map is kept as GIS parcel maps), but no queryable ArcGIS/WFS/OGC zoning district service was found. County GIS page and interactive map are viewers; the county open data hub exposes no zoning layer for the county; gis.gscplanning.com has a Zoning MapServer but it is Georgetown-Scott County, KY data (Kentucky coordinates, no layers exposed). Gate City's zoning is only in a third-party iamgis viewer. Virginia's Scott County parcel service on ArcGIS Online requires a token.
